properties.description: Successful storage account key-list action. Ordinary portal/automation also matches; no key material is queried or included. Disabled lab definition; no incident creation or automation.
properties.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(1h) .. now())
| where OperationNameValue in~ ("Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/listKeys/action")
| where ActivityStatusValue in~ ("Success", "Succeeded")
| where isnotempty(EventDataId)
| extend TargetResourceId = coalesce(ResourceId, _ResourceId)
| extend SourceIPAddress = iff(CallerIpAddress !contains "/" and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(CallerIpAddress)), CallerIpAddress, "")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationNameValue, ActivityStatusValue, Caller, SourceIPAddress, TargetResourceId, ResourceGroup, CorrelationId, EventDataId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventDataId
